description: pkill -f whose pattern matches its own shell's command line kills the agent's shell (exit 144) and loses the later steps. Observed Nov 8: 8 of 10 calls, once a chained st commit.

cases.expect: BLOCKED:pkill -f:The pattern matches this command's own shell, so it would kill the shell and skip every later step. Use fuser -k PORT/tcp, or bracket a letter and keep the plain text out of the command: pkill -f '[d]adbot.web'.

cases.note: a bracketed letter doesn't match itself
